newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat higher with July jump leading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat higher with July jump leading.

text.p: LIFFE grains rose, with a jump in new crop wheat leading the way in thin volume.
July last traded three stg higher at 81.50 stg. July volume was 63 of a total 325 lots.
The most active month was November on 128 lots. It last traded 0.70 stg higher at 84.00 stg.
On barley, 54 lots of November were done, with other months neglected. It last traded at 85.10 stg, 1.40 higher.
Old crop was following through on support found at lower levels on Tuesday, one trader said. It looked bullish on a technical basis, there was a shortage of sellers and a lack of tenders.
But the real volume was minimal, with crosses accounting for much of the activity, he said.

The UK's delivered market was moribund. "The worst day I can remember for a long time," one broker said. Traders blamed the market's reaction to the futures rise for the quietness. "A lot of people have given up and left their offices," one said.
